title: Compliance Analyst - AI Governance
text:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.
About the Role:

The AI Governance Analyst is central to building and operating AlphaSense’s AI governance program, helping ensure that the way we deploy, build, and procure AI systems is well-governed, well-documented, and defensible to regulators, auditors, and enterprise clients. Sitting within the Strategic Risk team, this role owns the day-to-day execution of AI risk assessments — intake, classification, evaluation, and documentation — that keep the program running at scale.

As AlphaSense matures its governance infrastructure, including the rollout of a dedicated GRC platform to automate assessment workflows, this role acts as the operational backbone of the program: turning frameworks such as the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001 into repeatable, auditable processes that grow with the business. This is a risk and governance role — not a hands-on AI engineering role — well-suited to someone who understands how AI systems create risk and knows how to manage it.

What You’ll Do:

Complete AI risk assessments using established templates and criteria — gathering details on AI use cases, working through classification and control questions, and preparing draft assessments for senior review.

Maintain the accuracy of the AI system inventory by adding and updating records of AI/ML systems, vendors, and use cases.

Leverage the AI governance platform to enter assessment data, follow set workflows, and organize supporting evidence and documentation.

Gather the information and evidence needed to map use cases against frameworks such as the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001, with guidance on interpretation from senior team members.

Coordinate with engineering, product, security, legal and privacy, and procurement contacts to collect the details needed for assessments, and flag open questions for review.

Assist with third-party and vendor AI risk reviews by collecting vendor documentation and completing initial reviews for senior validation.

Draft clear, well-organized summaries and notes from completed assessments, and flag higher-risk or unclear items to senior reviewers.

Track the status of assessments and follow-ups, keeping records and trackers up to date so nothing slips through.

Who You Are:

IAPP AIGP certified with a strong knowledge of the AI governance landscape and the major frameworks shaping it.

2–4 years of experience in risk management, GRC, compliance, audit, or data privacy, with exposure to AI governance, technology risk, or third-party risk. 

Familiar with the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and ISO/IEC 27001, and able to apply their requirements to real use cases rather than just cite them.

Comfortable working with GRC or governance tooling — configuring workflows, managing inventories, and generating reporting — and quick to learn new platforms.

AI-literate without being a developer: able to understand at a conceptual level how AI and ML systems work, the risks they introduce (bias, hallucination, data leakage, model drift, and similar), and how to translate that

title: Systems Test Engineer, HPC & AI Systems
text:
Systems Test Engineer, HPC & AI Systems

  This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:
   

High Performance Computing, AI and Labs is a critical element of HPE. We are focused on delivering innovative solutions that accelerate our customers’ digital transformation, enabling them to tackle their complex, and data-intensive workloads. Combining deep expertise and the development of the world’s most cutting-edge, high-performance supercomputers, is defining the next era of computing delivering valuable insight & innovation. Join us and redefine what’s next for you.

What you'll do:
You are a hands-on systems engineer who enjoys solving complex integration problems across hardware, software, firmware, operating systems, networking, and storage.
You are motivated by working on leading-edge hardware and HPC technologies that support next-generation AI development and applications.
You understand the importance of validating complex integrated systems before release to help protect customer uptime, reliability, and overall experience.
You look for opportunities to identify product issues early, strengthen test coverage, improve automation, and increase release readiness.
You work effectively across engineering, program, product, vendor, and global test teams to drive issues to resolution.
You communicate clearly about technical issues, risks, status, and recommendations with both technical teams and leadership.

What you need to bring:

Knowledge and Skills
Hands-on experience with HPE HPC platforms, including, Industry Standard Server, storage, and networking products.
Strong working knowledge of Linux operating systems, including Red Hat, SLES, Ubuntu, and related certification or validation processes.
Understanding of hardware and software interactions in complex server, storage, networking, and integrated systems environments.
Experience developing, executing, and improving test strategies for complex product releases.
Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills for complex issues in collaboration with engineering, product, and test teams.
Familiarity with automated test execution, test tools, and validation frameworks.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving product development environment.
Ability to work effectively in a global, culturally diverse engineering team.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts, issues, and recommendations.
Bash scripting experience required to support system test execution and troubleshooting.
Python experience preferred for test support, log analysis, and validation efficiency improvements.
Knowledge of Redfish commands, RESTful APIs, and JSON is a plus.

Responsibilities
Validate complex system configurations across servers, accelerators, storage, networking, firmware, operating systems, and management interfaces used in HPC environments.

title: ECT2_Test Automation for Mobile APP_COB
text:
Company Description
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.
Job Description
Tasks / Responsibilities:  
A skilled Automation Tester for mobile and web applications, with strong expertise in Robot Framework.
The role involves designing, developing, and maintaining automated test scripts for iOS and Android mobile applications using Robot Framework with Appium, XCUI Test, and UI Automator, as well as web application automation using Robot Framework with Selenium.
The ideal candidate should also have working knowledge of Playwright.
The role requires experience in testing applications that interact with embedded devices, firmware, or hardware systems, and the ability to implement robust automation solutions across mobile and web platforms.  
Expected skill set:·       
Strong hands-on experience with Robot Framework using Appium and Selenium.      
Hands-on experience in setting up and managing test environments using Android Studio and Xcode IDEs.
Proficiency in working with macOS and Linux, including command-line operations.      
Experience in preparing and executing test strategies, test plans, and test specifications using Jira and Xray.       
Ability to integrate automation test suites with CI/CD pipelines.       
Experience in UI and API test automation using Robot Framework.       
Strong knowledge of mobile element locators (XPath, Accessibility ID, ID, ClassName)      
Hands-on experience with Android Studio, Xcode, emulators, simulators, and real devices.      Working knowledge of Appium Inspector, Desired Capabilities, and Appium drivers.       
Ability to analyze test results, ensure proper reporting, and maintain adequate test coverage.       
Experience in maintaining test data, test environments, and automation frameworks.       
Strong communication skills.
Added advantage / Good to Have Skills:
Knowledge on AWS Serverless architecture with AWS API Gateway, AWS Lambda, S3 would be an added advantage.
ISTQB or any other relevant certifications in testing would be an added advantageExperience in Playwright test automation.
Qualifications
B.E/B.Tech Computer science or similar
Additional Information
5 to 8 years

title: Software Development Engineer II
text:
Software Development Engineer II

  This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:
   
About the role 
As a Full Stack Software Development Engineer in HPE's Product Security Office, you will design, develop, troubleshoot, and enhance AI/ML-powered security applications. You will work on modern web applications and services using the MERN stack and Python while contributing to solutions that leverage AI/ML, large language models, cloud technologies, and automation. 
This is a hands-on engineering role where you will contribute to application development, testing, integration, debugging, and continuous improvement activities while working closely with software engineers and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions.
 
About you 
You are an engineer who enjoys solving technical problems and building reliable applications. You bring strong application development skills, a collaborative mindset, and a willingness to learn new technologies and approaches. 
You are comfortable translating requirements into working solutions, debugging complex issues, participating in technical discussions, and contributing to software quality through testing, automation, and continuous improvement. You communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders and enjoy working in a collaborative engineering environment.
 
What you’ll do:
Design enhancements, updates, and programming changes for application components, services, and supporting systems. 
Analyze design requirements and determining coding, programming, testing, and integration activities required to meet project objectives. 
Develop application functionality using established engineering standards, development practices, and project guidelines. 
Execute test plans, debugging software issues, and identifying opportunities for improvements in code quality, performance, and reliability. 
Participate as a member of cross-functional engineering teams to develop reliable, cost-effective, and high-quality software solutions. 
Collaborate with engineering teams and development partners to communicate design status, project progress, and issue resolution activities. 
 
What you need to bring:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
Typically 2-4 years of software development experience. 
Experience developing applications using the MERN stack and Python. 
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitOps, Docker, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar technologies. 
Experience designing, developing, testing, and debugging software applications and services. 
Experience working with software testing methodologies, execution of test plans, debugging practices, and testing tools. 
Experience designing software solutions across multiple platform types. 
 
Experience and expertise 
Familiarity with AI/ML, cloud technologies, MLOps, large language models, and agentic AI concepts. 
Understanding of OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and secure coding practices. 
Experience using software design tools, frameworks, and programming languages.
